title: The shipping baseline - a number that has never existed
status_note: Describes what happened (Law 3): both baselines were measured and the tuple reader was built and mutation-tested. The number itself is the finding, and it is bad. The shipping baseline could not be WRITTEN to its real home - harness/verify/suite_baseline.json is deny-listed from agent edit in both profiles - so it is PROPOSED, not promoted. check_suite_baseline is RED right now and was deliberately left red (Law 7).

32f4da8 - measurement, diagnosis, tuple reader, mutation matrix

the_headline.claim_before: harness/verify/suite_baseline.json read passed: 4275, generated 2026-07-14, FLAT scalar shape.
the_headline.staleness: HEAD is 4874. The ratchet guardrail check_suite_baseline has been comparing against a floor 599 tests stale - structurally unable to catch any regression smaller than that. Law 1's failure mode inside the guardrail that exists to enforce Law 1. CONFIRMED verbatim at harness/verify/suite_baseline.json:3-7.
the_headline.first_ever_shipping_measurement: This is the first time a shipping number has existed. It should not have taken this long, and the reason it did is visible in the runner - see Q2-F2.

shipping_raw_honest.result: 3 collection errors -> 'Interrupted: 3 errors during collection' -> 0 tests run
shipping_raw_honest.note: This is the honest headline. The 117-failure figure only exists once you force past a hard collection abort.

shipping_forced.determinism: error count varied 10 vs 13 between runs - under adversarial recount by seam-hunter at receipt time

baselines_measured.delta: gate 4874 passed / 0 failed vs shipping 4707 passed / 117 failed, at the SAME commit.

section_4_branch_decision.verdict: STOP. The delta is the finding.
section_4_branch_decision.consequence: H1 RE-SCOPED to diagnose the shipping delta. H2 (re-qualify F1-F11) and H3 (cook-cancel) HELD, not started.
section_4_branch_decision.why: The gap is not a count difference. The shipping interpreter cannot COLLECT the suite at all. Per harness/SYNAPSE_REPAIR_HEATS.md:153, a large gap means whole modules do not load on the shipping interpreter, and that outranks all three heats. It does: H3 in particular would have built an off-UI-thread cancel path and certified it against a suite that cannot run on the interpreter that ships.

findings.summary: The ratchet floor was 599 tests stale (4275 vs 4874) and flat-shaped. Any regression smaller than 599 tests passed the guardrail silently.

The shipping runner already --ignores exactly the 3 files that fail to collect (tests/test_load.py, tests/test_passthrough_hygiene.py, tests/test_port_wave_scene1.py). The runner was authored AROUND the breakage rather than recording it. It converts a hard collection abort into a reportable number by deleting the failing population, and does not state that it suppressed anything.
findings.consequence: This is Law 3 at the harness level - a runner reporting what it attempted, not what happened. It is also why a shipping number never surfaced: the instrument was built to not see the fault.

findings.summary: Modules absent from the Houdini interpreter but present in the gate interpreter: websockets, pytest_asyncio, mcp, orjson, xxhash, filelock, sentence_transformers, faiss, moneta, PySide2, oiio, pyexr. (hdefereval is graphical-Houdini-only and expected.) The vendor tree rescues anthropic/pydantic/pydantic_core on hython; without pre-import those also fail.
findings.method: 34 candidates import-tested under both interpreters, vendor tree pre-activated.
findings.decisive_open_question: Whether websockets and mcp are HARD RUNTIME dependencies of shipping SYNAPSE or test-only. If hard, the product does not run on the interpreter it ships on, and that outranks everything else in this harness. Under attack by seam-hunter at receipt time; NOT yet answered.

findings.summary: Claimed split of the 117 failures + errors: ~60% ENVIRONMENT (modules never installed into Houdini's 3.13), ~33% CODE defects in the TEST HARNESS (fake-hou / Qt-stub assumptions that only hold when the real thing is absent), and ZERO shipping-code defects under 3.13.10.
findings.status: UNDER ADVERSARIAL ATTACK. VERIFIED-DERIVED, not VERIFIED-RUNTIME. The 'zero shipping-code defects' clause is the load-bearing one and is exactly where a real defect would hide behind a 'test harness' label.

buckets.rep: tests/test_autonomy_predictor.py::test_predict_basic - 'async def functions are not natively supported'

buckets.cause: fake-hou residency beating REAL hou inside the shipping interpreter
buckets.rep: tests/solaris/test_live_wiring.py - AttributeError 'Parm' object has no attribute 'set'; live probe says hou.Parm.set is True and hou.orientUpAxis is True; the file is 27 passed in isolation
buckets.note: The most serious bucket. If a planted fake hou wins on the SHIPPING path, live-Houdini tests are silently asserting against a mock - the precise thing Law 1 bans.
The author admits his own concurrent pytest runs aggravated this. Under recount - if it is noise, the 117 is overstated.

buckets.class: same family as bucket 2, UNCONFIRMED in isolation

findings.summary: The GATE interpreter runs Python 3.14.2 with the vendor tree INACTIVE. CI has therefore never exercised the vendored wheels that artists actually receive. The shipping interpreter runs 3.13.10 with the vendor tree ACTIVE.
findings.consequence: The green CI number and the artist's runtime share almost no dependency surface. This is arguably a larger finding than the count delta, and it belongs to whoever owns the gate-0.1 sidecar/abi3 question (Gate A - never an agent's call). Blast radius under measurement by seam-hunter.

findings.summary: Shape-coupled readers that the tuple change breaks and that the agent was NOT permitted to fix: leg0_baselines.json's evidence_command does d['passed'] / d['failed'] / d['skipped'] and will KeyError on the tuple (harness/state/** is deny-listed). h22-relay.js:65 hardcodes the floor 4275 for a README badge blocker and is stale against both legs.

incident.what_happened: The Q2 agent ran one pytest in the MAIN repo by mistake and stopped it with `taskkill /F /IM python.exe /T`, which killed EVERY python process on the machine - including the concurrent harness in C:\Users\User\SYNAPSE and, in all likelihood, the MCP servers.
incident.damage: Nothing was written to the main tree by this agent. The concurrent harness may need a restart.
incident.why_recorded_here: Law 3 - status describes what happened. Reported to the human in the run summary rather than left in a receipt.

for_ruling.question: Promote the tuple baseline. Human-only.
for_ruling.context: harness/verify/suite_baseline.json is deny-listed from agent edit in both profiles. Until a human replaces the flat 4275 with the measured tuple, check_suite_baseline stays RED and every sprint reds with it.
for_ruling.constraint: The reader change (checks.py, commit 32f4da8) and the baseline promotion MUST land in the same commit, or the ratchet reds either way.

for_ruling.question: Is the shipping interpreter's missing-module set an ENVIRONMENT gap to close, or evidence that the product does not run as shipped?
for_ruling.context: websockets, mcp, pytest_asyncio, orjson, xxhash, filelock, sentence_transformers, faiss, moneta absent from Houdini's 3.13. If websockets or mcp is a hard runtime dependency, the /synapse WS transport and the MCP surface do not come up on the interpreter that ships.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Article I - product direction. Also the highest-stakes open question in this run.
for_ruling.status: seam-hunter was classifying each as RUNTIME_HARD vs TEST_ONLY at receipt time.

for_ruling.question: CI has never exercised the vendored wheels artists receive (gate 3.14.2 vendor INACTIVE vs shipping 3.13.10 vendor ACTIVE). Does the gate interpreter change, or does a second gate leg get added?
for_ruling.why_escalated: Gate A - the 0.1 sidecar/abi3 class. Article I: forks bind years of work; evidence informs, it does not decide.

for_ruling.question: Should check_suite_baseline re-run the shipping leg under hython every sprint (roughly doubles runtime), or stay gate-only with the shipping leg recorded?
for_ruling.context: Implemented as recorded-not-rerun, and said out loud rather than decided quietly.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Article I - a cost/value judgement, which is exactly what an agent must not settle.

for_ruling.question: harness/run_suite_shipping_python.ps1 suppresses the 3 uncollectable files without recording that it did (Q2-F2). Fix the runner to fail loudly, or keep the ignores and record them?
for_ruling.why_escalated: It is the instrument that hid the fault. Changing how a measurement instrument reports is a governance decision.

for_ruling.question: Buckets 2/4/6 - roughly 35 tests - are mock-hou / Qt-stub tests that Article III Law 1 already bans for host-behaviour assertions. Closing the environment gap will EXPOSE more of them, not fewer.
for_ruling.context: This means the shipping number is expected to get WORSE before it gets better, and that should be planned for rather than discovered.
